page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7se.8xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud server belonging to the Enhanced family, designed for workloads requiring a substantial memory footprint per execution thread. It runs on the KVM hypervisor and is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.9 GHz. The instance delivers 32 dedicated vCPUs distributed across 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The CPU cache architecture comprises 48 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 48 MB L3 cache, backed by vector extensions including AVX-512 and AVX-512 VNNI.

Hardware allocation includes 256.0 GB of system RAM, establishing an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio with 8.0 GB of memory per thread. The server does not bundle dedicated local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage options. For connectivity, it features a 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, accommodating sustained inter-service and data-tier communication across cloud infrastructures.

Benchmark evaluations demonstrate consistent mid-tier compute capabilities paired with high memory efficiency. The platform achieved a PassMark memory score of 2,804.95, placing it in the top 25 percent of tested systems. Large-block memory bandwidth registers 155.4 GB/s for uncached reads and 69.83 GB/s for writes. Compute evaluations returned average-tier results, including a multi-core Geekbench score of 13,505.0, a PassMark CPU score of 36,823.03, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression at 161.41 GB/s. Small-model LLM text generation achieved an upper-quartile result of 311.53 tokens per second, while Redis throughput reached 31.42 million SET operations per second.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high RAM density provides favorable hardware utilization for in-memory systems without necessitating over-provisioned compute cores. However, the absence of local NVMe storage requires architects to evaluate external network storage latency for write-heavy pipelines. Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7se.8xlarge is well-suited for enterprise in-memory databases, Redis and Memcached caching tiers, large-scale ETL pipelines, and data analytics engines.
